meta.title: The Salt Road
meta.author: Example
meta.logline: A caravan master discovers the truce she has been hauling salt under was sold to her by the man who broke it.

mara.name: Mara Vale
mara.role: Caravan master of the Ash Guild
mara.need: Admit she left the valley for a reason, and that the reason was fear
mara.want: Get the salt carts through the ford before the thaw

voice.rhythm: Short declaratives. Rarely more than one clause per sentence.
tics: counts on her fingers while thinking
tells: goes quiet before she gets dangerous

traits: loyal to her crews before her guild

relationships.note: he held the ford for her once, and she has not forgotten
the guild bought her carts; she owes them a season

harek.name: Harek
harek.need: Be seen as more than the man his father bought the post for
harek.want: Keep the ford closed until the duke's factor pays him

voice.register: Formal, too precise, a man performing competence
voice.rhythm: Long sentences that circle the point and never land on it
tics: repeats your last three words back to you

relationships.note: she saw him take the purse and said nothing

ilse.name: Ilse of the Factor's Office
ilse.role: The duke's factor at the ford
ilse.need: Matter to a court that sends her to count salt
ilse.want: Close the season's ledger without a shortage

relationships.note: an unlicensed caravan is a line item, not a person

ash-guild.name: The Ash Guild
friction: the western houses want the ford wardenship for their own candidate
the guild's clerk has been selling tallies to the factor's office

ducal-office.name: The Duke's Factor Office
friction: the duke has not read a ledger in two years

salt-is-scarce.statement: No salt crosses the ford without the duke's seal. There is no exception, and no one has ever been forgiven for one.

ford-is-haunted.statement: The locals say the ford is haunted by the men who drowned building it.

truce-broken.statement: The truce at the ford was broken three weeks ago; the road is closed to unsealed traffic.

harek-burned-the-ford.statement: It was Harek who ordered the ford burned, not the raiders.

the-seal-is-forged.statement: The seal on Ilse's writ is a forgery; the duke's office has not issued a writ this season.

ilse-bought-the-warden.statement: Ilse paid Harek two hundredweight of salt to close the ford.

who-burned-the-ford.label: Someone burned the ford and let the raiders take the blame.
who-burned-the-ford.note: the smell of lamp oil is the first clue

the-forged-seal.label: Ilse's writ carries a seal that does not match the register.

scenes.title: The ford
scenes.summary: Mara brings her carts to a ford that is closed, and is told the truce broke three weeks ago.

changes.note: he is apologetic, which is not the same as sorry

scenes.title: The tally
scenes.summary: Ilse arrives to count the guild's carts and shows a writ Mara has seen the register for.

dependencies.note: a closed ford is what brings the factor out to count

changes.note: the seal is wrong and Ilse knows it is wrong

scenes.title: Ash on the water
scenes.summary: Mara finds lamp oil in the reeds and works out who ordered the ford burned.
scenes.value_end: certainty, and no proof anyone will accept

dependencies.note: if the writ is forged, the closure is not the duke's doing

changes.note: he burned the ford and let her think it was raiders

scenes.title: The seal
scenes.summary: Mara puts the forged seal in front of the guild and makes them choose.

dependencies.note: knowing is not the same as being believed
